raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / NEW DEVELOPMENTS / VILLA MODERNA CON PISCINA – JESOLO PAESE NEW DEVELOPMENT · VILLA Villa Moderna con Piscina – Jesolo Paese JESOLO PAESE · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €590,000 Photos (13) Floor plans (0) 1 / 13 FLOOR AREA 200 m² BEDROOMS 3 BATHROOMS 2 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview Welcome to your new home in Jesolo Paese! In the new and sought-after residential area of Jesolo Paese, Campana zone, ideal for those who desire privacy, design, and comfortable living. The property is developed entirely on a single level, distinguished by modern architectural lines and spacious bright environments. The living area of over 45 sqm represents the heart of the house: an elegant and functional space perfect for enjoying moments of togetherness in a refined setting. Outside, a covered porch overlooking the private pool creates a natural continuity between indoors and outdoors, offering an ideal space for outdoor lunches and evenings. The sleeping area consists of: Three spacious bedrooms designed to ensure maximum comfort and privacy, Two modern bathrooms made with quality finishes designed to meet every need. The property is built according to the highest construction standards, energy class A4, ensuring maximum energy savings, sustainability, and quality living. Possibility of customizing interiors thanks to collaboration with specialized partners in design and furnishings to create a tailor-made home. We consider exchanges to facilitate purchase. Ideal solution both as a primary residence or as a valuable investment.
